messages:
incident-bot: RED: spike in 504s for eu1 inference frontends (5m p95 504 = 12% > threshold 1%). Synthetic canary probes are also failing with timeout errors. Alerting channel: #eng-oncall.
cheng (oncall): seeing it in the dashboard now. customer-facing errors started ~04:00 UTC?
maya: confirmed — top customer support tickets referencing LLM requests timing out. severity: P1?
sanjay: quick sanity check: any deploys around 03:50-04:05 UTC? I see a small routing config change pushed by infra-team.
tess (sre): @sanjay +1. I’m paging infra and runtime. Can we mute noisy synth alerts while we investigate? They’re causing a lot of duplicate pages.
eva: temporary mute ok but keep a digest in the channel. Set synth backoff to 60s? current is 10s which is spamming.
kyle: +1 to backoff. Also increase failure threshold to 3 consecutive failures before alert.
cheng (oncall): doing a quick mitigation: increasing synthetic probe debounce and backoff. Command I’ll run in control plane: 
```
redwood probes update --selector eu1-canary --backoff 60s --failure-window 3
```
maya: also flipping on a traffic-failover to older router pool for eu1 (low risk) — will hold a 5 min canary traffic shift first.
sanjay: infra confirms the routing config change was a minor header tweak; rolling back is an option if we see customer error rate not drop.
tess (sre): log snippet from frontends at 04:02: 
```
[04:02:11] frontend-12 - upstream timeout after 8s - connection reset - trace_id=abc123
[04:02:14] frontend-09 - 504 gateway - backend latency spike 7.8s
```
cheng (oncall): after soft backoff and canary traffic shift: p95 504 dropped to 2.1% at 04:10 — still above goal but improving. synth failures dropped from 60/min to 6/min.
eva: customer impact: three support tickets escalated, batch job retries failed for one partner integration. Not widespread but visible.
kyle: recommend the following immediate actions: 1) keep probes backoff 60s and failure-window=3 2) keep canary traffic shifted for 15 min 3) open dashboard for quick ops.
maya: creating a temporary dashboard widget for error rate by router pool and by model to see if specific model hosts are implicated.
sanjay: infra will snapshot routing config and prepare rollback if we see plateau after 10 more mins.
tess (sre): I’ll also create an alert that only fires if customer-facing 5m 504 > 3% AND synthetic failures > 15/min — to reduce false positives from isolated backend blips.
eva: please add runbook steps into this thread when you make changes. Good to capture for post-incident tuning.
cheng (oncall): done with the probe change and deploy annotations: probe backoff & threshold updated, canary traffic at 20% on old-router-pool. Notifying SRE rotation.
maya: posting rollback ready note to infra: rollback on /routes/v1 if needed.
sanjay: infra sees small increase in socket queue on router-11 03:58-04:05. Could be due to header tweak causing connection reuse issues. Investigating.
tess (sre): follow-up tasks for post-incident tuning: - add synth probe histogram to correlate latency distribution - reduce synth probe frequency to 30s only for low-risk routes - add automatic dampening rule: if synth flaps > X then increase failure-window to avoid page storms.
kyle: agree. Also propose a new dashboard card showing probe failure-streaks (consecutive failures) so we can tune threshold semantics rather than raw failure counts.
eva: customer comms: CX team draft ready, hold until we confirm root cause.
cheng (oncall): at 04:18 UTC p95 504 now 0.8% — back under threshold. Rolling canary back to normal routing, leaving probes at backoff 60s for 30 mins.
maya: reverting canary traffic to normal. Note: we kept the router config snapshot.
sanjay: infra found a header flapping bug in the routing edge which caused connection churn under load. Fix PR opened and queued for low-risk patch tomorrow.
tess (sre): incident summary notes for postmortem: cause = routing header churn -> increased backend latency; mitigations = probe backoff, temporary traffic shift, probe alert dampening rule; customer impact = limited 504s, 3 escalations. Action items: dashboard cards, probe-streak metric, automatic dampening rule, infra patch.
cheng (oncall): handing off to next oncall (tess) for final follow-up and post-incident tasks. Thank you all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: 504 spike mitigated and probes dampened. Resolution time: 20m.
